system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Once a skill is matched, the system performs structured context assembly rather than simply appending text to the prompt.
system_prompt_style.note: Paper-only (repo URL given but no code in bundle). Skill injection plus SOUL.md/USER.md/MEMORY.md suggest runtime composition. The 2406.14228 paper is a different system with the same name.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: this stage encodes the user input using an external embedding API and computes cosine similarity with existing skill descriptions
env_context_strategy.note: Retrieval selects skills (not repo snippets): keyword, then embedding, then LLM matching. This is the closest value; the mismatch is that skills are retrieved rather than repository snippets.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: the system monitors token usage in real time and triggers a history compression module when approaching the limit
context_compaction.note: Compression is triggered above 64K tokens (Sec. 4.3.1) and builds an 'asset index'.

observation_format.note: No code was available to check how observations are converted.

tool_call_format.note: No parser code in the evidence.

tool_count.note: No tool registry in the evidence.

edit_primitive.note: No tool definitions in the evidence.

tool_schema_source.note: No schema code in the evidence.

protocol_standardization.note: No source or dependencies were available to grep.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The system employs the ReAct loop to implement reasoning and action, optimizes context utilization through a progressive disclosure strategy, and supports structured outputs and event-driven interaction.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: the main agent decomposes high-level objectives and assigns subtasks to specialized sub-agents with domain-specific capabilities
planning_granularity.note: Paper-only; no plan object is shown.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: enables the main agent to create specialized sub-agents with independent context spaces on demand
multi_agent_topology.note: It is unclear whether this is the default configuration.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: enables the main agent to create specialized sub-agents with independent context spaces on demand

human_in_loop.note: The paper mentions profile updates 'finalized upon user confirmation', but that is not action gating. No config surface was available.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: composed of a quadruple including dialogue history, user profile, skill repository state, and context compression state

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Constructs a three-layer memory system (SOUL.md/USER.md/MEMORY .md) combined with a dialogue history compression mechanism
long_term_memory.note: Skills are stored in configs/skills/{name}/. The vector store is inferred from embedding matching over skill descriptions.

self_verification.note: LLM-as-Judge is used only in the paper's evaluation, not in the harness.

cost_controls.note: The paper states it 'lacks cost tracking' (Sec. 4.3.2), which is not a config surface.

tracing.note: The paper says the system lacks monitoring dashboards; no code was available.

target_domain.evidence_quote: This paper proposes EvoAgent, an evolvable unified agent framework designed for real-world foreign trade scenarios.

open_source.note: The paper says code 'will be released'; no LICENSE file was in the evidence.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: We select GPT4.1 [25] and Qwen3.5-35B-A3B [26] as baselines
model_agnostic.note: Swapping models is shown experimentally; no client abstraction was seen.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: Code, data, and documents will be released at https://github.com/Focus-AI-Center/Mentarc-EvoAgent.git.
primary_artifact.note: No repository content was in the evidence.

first_release_date.note: Paper v1 date is not given; only v3 (24 Jun 2026) is shown.
